lines.en: label beachsevenwakana2:
scene wakanasex1
: I like Charles Baudelaire. I like Sylvia Plath. I like Algernon Charles Swinburne.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢夏尔·波德莱尔。我喜欢西尔维娅·普拉斯。我喜欢阿尔杰农·查尔斯·斯温伯恩。

lines.en: : There’s no way some nihilistic goth girl in her twenties dislikes Sylvia Plath, so I’m going to say Swinburne is the lie.
lines.zh: : 一个二十多岁的虚无主义哥特女不可能不喜欢西尔维娅·普拉斯，所以我说斯温伯恩是假话。

lines.en: : Why him and not Baudelaire?
lines.zh: : 为什么是他而不是波德莱尔？

lines.en: : Because Baudelaire wrote the Flowers of Evil and you like flowers.
lines.zh: : 因为波德莱尔写了《恶之花》，而你喜欢花。

lines.en: : Pretty flimsy reasoning, Arakawa. You intend to stake your guess on that and that alone?
lines.zh: : 理由相当牵强啊，Arakawa。你打算就凭这个下注？

lines.en: : There’s not really much at stake here apart from bragging rights, so sure. I’m locking in the answer.
lines.zh: : 反正除了吹牛的资格也没什么好赌的，行吧。我锁定答案了。

lines.en: : Then you’ll be happy to know that you are, once again, correct. How infuriating.
lines.zh: : 那你听了会很高兴——你又答对了。真气人。

lines.en: : Guess this just means I like you more than you like me.
lines.zh: : 看来这说明我喜欢你，胜过你喜欢我。

lines.en: : Such information is already known to all. How am I to match your affection for me when you are nothing short of obsessed?
lines.zh: : 这种事早就人尽皆知了。你对我简直就是痴迷，我哪比得上你对我的这份情意？

lines.en: : You’re right. Any {i}more{/i} obsessed and I’d be staying up late at night studying your background in an attempt to get to know you better behind the scenes.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。{i}再{/i}痴迷一点，我就要熬夜研究你的背景资料，好私下里更了解你了。

lines.en: : One day, you will stop hanging that over my head. And when you do, I hope it is because you have died.
lines.zh: : 总有一天你会不再拿这事压在我头上。等你不再提的那天，我希望是因为你已经死了。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if this means you’re wishing for my swift death or that I will torment you until death do us part.
lines.zh: : 我不知道这是在咒我快点死，还是在说我会折磨你，直到死亡把我们分开。

lines.en: scene wakanasex2
: Would it kill you or not kill you to use language more suited to calming one whose proposal was so recently rejected?
lines.zh: : 说点更适合安抚一个刚被拒婚的人的话——是会要了你的命，还是要不了你的命？

lines.en: : Tell me which of those you’d prefer and I will give you my answer.
lines.zh: : 告诉我是哪一种，我就给你答案。

lines.en: : I am so insanely drunk right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在醉得要命。

lines.en: : I can tell. You’ve been touching my hand for thirty minutes.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来。你已经摸我的手摸了三十分钟了。

lines.en: scene wakanasex3
: I’ve been reading your palm.
lines.zh: : 我是在看你的手相。

lines.en: : Then you’re either very bad at it or there’s just a lot written there.
lines.zh: : 那你要么是很不擅长，要么就是上面写的东西实在太多了。

lines.en: : I imagine it’s a mix of both. It’s been a while since I’ve done something like this.
lines.zh: : 我猜两者都有。我已经很久没做这种事了。

lines.en: : Want to pull out your tarot cards while you’re at it? Burn some sage to expel all of the demons in the room?
lines.zh: : 要不要顺便把塔罗牌也拿出来？烧点鼠尾草，把房间里的恶魔都驱走？

lines.en: : I’d need to burn an entire field of sage to expel any demons you dragged in, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 要驱走你招来的那些恶魔，得烧掉一整片鼠尾草田才行，Arakawa。

lines.en: : What does my palm say?
lines.zh: : 我的手相说了什么？

lines.en: : That you’ll ultimately be the reason this world expires. And that you’re the worst man who has ever walked the face of the planet he is about to destroy.
lines.zh: : 说这个世界最终会毁在你手里。还说你是这颗即将被你毁掉的星球上，有史以来最烂的男人。

lines.en: : Is that actually what it says or are you just riffing?
lines.zh: : 它真是这么说的，还是你在瞎编？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. Ask me again when I am sober. Which may never happen again, but I digress.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。等我清醒了再问我吧。虽然我可能再也不会清醒了，不过我扯远了。

lines.en: scene wakanasex4
: Also, stop stalling and give me your truths. We’re not done playing yet.
lines.zh: : 还有，别磨蹭了，说你的真话。我们还没玩完呢。

lines.en: : You sure you don’t want to try and sleep? It’s well past midnight now.
lines.zh: : 你确定不想试着睡一下？已经过午夜很久了。

lines.en: : I can’t fall asleep before you. You’ll take advantage of me.
lines.zh: : 我不能比你先睡着。你会趁机占我便宜。

lines.en: : Then should I go to sleep? Because you’re so drunk right now that I’m afraid you might do the same.
lines.zh: : 那我该去睡了？因为你现在醉成这样，我怕你反而会占我便宜。

lines.en: : I have zero interest in sleeping with you, Arakawa. Do not confuse me wishing to sleep {i}beside{/i} you for that, please.
lines.zh: : 我对你一点兴趣都没有，Arakawa。别把我想睡在你{i}身边{/i}误会成那个意思，拜托。

lines.en: : Zero? Really?
lines.zh: : 一点？真的？

lines.en: : Really.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : You’re very touchy for someone with zero interest then. My palm’s already been read and you’re still just playing with my hand.
lines.zh: : 那你这个「一点兴趣都没有」的人可真爱动手动脚。手相都看完了，你还在玩我的手。

lines.en: scene wakanasex5
: Fine. I suppose I’ll just let go then.
lines.zh: : 行吧。那我就松手好了。

lines.en: : You’re just playing with my shirt now instead.
lines.zh: : 你现在改玩我的衬衫了。

lines.en: : I get fidgety when I can’t fall asleep.
lines.zh: : 睡不着的时候我就爱乱动。

lines.en: : Have you thought for a second that you might only be struggling to do that because you keep talking to me?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过，你之所以睡不着，可能只是因为你一直在跟我说话？

lines.en: : I’m still waiting on your truths.
lines.zh: : 我还等着你的真话呢。

lines.en: : Are you not excited for the lie?
lines.zh: : 你就不期待那个假话吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly. Lies don’t teach me anything else about you.
lines.zh: : 没什么特别期待的。假话教不了我更多关于你的事。

lines.en: : I could just tell you if you have any questions, Wakana. You don’t need to gamify getting to know me better. You already got me into bed.
lines.zh: : 你有任何问题都可以直接问我，Wakana。你不用把了解我变成一场游戏。你已经把我弄上床了。

lines.en: : Getting you into bed is far easier than learning things about you, Arakawa. But I suppose, if you’re willing, I can just ask a few things outright.
lines.zh: : 把你弄上床，可比了解你容易多了，Arakawa。不过既然你愿意，我想我也可以直接问几件事。

lines.en: : Like?
lines.zh: : 比如？

lines.en: : Do {i}you{/i} ever hope to be married?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}有没有想过结婚？

lines.en: : Why? Do you still have the ring and want to put it good use?
lines.zh: : 怎么？戒指还在你手上，想拿来物尽其用？

lines.en: : Be serious.
lines.zh: : 正经点。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许吧。

lines.en: : I think I’d mostly just want it if the person I fell for wanted it. Similar to how it was with you and Osako, I assume.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我主要还是看我爱上的那个人想不想要。就像你和 Osako 那样，我猜。

lines.en: scene wakanasex6

: You’re right to a certain extent. {i}Marriage{/i} on its own never made much sense to me apart from its financial benefits. And even then, the only relationship I’ve ever had has been a same-sex one.
lines.zh: : 你在某种程度上说对了。{i}婚姻{/i}本身对我来说从来没什么意义，除了经济上的好处。再说，我唯一有过的这段感情还是同性的。

lines.en: : So it was never really about the {i}marriage{/i} part at all and more just a symbol of your love, right?
lines.zh: : 所以其实从来都不是{i}婚姻{/i}那部分，更多只是你们爱情的象征，对吧？

lines.en: scene wakanasex7
: Who would you choose out of anyone, Arakawa?
lines.zh: : Arakawa，如果在所有人里选，你会选谁？

lines.en: : Can I not say you?
lines.zh: : 我能不说你吗？

lines.en: : Imani? Your childhood friend? I suppose Rika may be a dark horse as well.
lines.zh: : Imani？你的青梅竹马？我想 Rika 也算匹黑马。

lines.en: : Okay. I guess I {i}can’t{/i} say you, then.
lines.zh: : 好。那我大概{i}不能{/i}说你了。

lines.en: : I already told you I’m not interested in lies.
lines.zh: : 我说过我对假话没兴趣。

lines.en: : I’m not really ready to make that choice, unfortunately. I can’t decide right now.
lines.zh: : 可惜我现在还没准备好做这个选择。我决定不了。

lines.en: : Do you hope to one day? Or do you intend to live the rest of your life as some womanizing scumbag who can’t ever settle for one person?
lines.zh: : 你希望有一天能决定吗？还是打算就这么当一辈子到处拈花惹草、永远没法为一个人安定下来的混蛋？

lines.en: : Easy for you to say when you’ve only {i}been{/i} with one person.
lines.zh: : 你这话倒是说得轻巧，毕竟你只跟一个人{i}在一起{/i}过。

lines.en: scene wakanasex8
: Yes, I suppose it is. Though, I can’t say I’ve had many other suitors to begin with. So it’s not as if such thoughts crossed my mind often.
lines.zh: : 是啊，大概吧。不过话说回来，我本来也没多少别的追求者。所以这种念头也不常冒出来。

lines.en: : That’s probably because you scare them all away. What sort of {i}suitor{/i} would pursue someone as terrifying as you?
lines.zh: : 那大概是因为你把他们全吓跑了。什么样的{i}追求者{/i}敢追像你这么吓人的人？

lines.en: : Am I really that scary?
lines.zh: : 我真有那么吓人吗？

lines.en: : You were at first. But now that I know who you really are, you’re about as intimidating as a stuffed bear.
lines.zh: : 一开始是。但现在我知道了你真正的样子，你也就跟一只毛绒熊差不多有威慑力。

lines.en: : And I’m sure there are plenty who’d say you’re as intimidating as a real one. Just goes to show you that people don’t always know what they’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我相信肯定有不少人会说，你的威慑力跟一只真熊差不多。可见人们说的话未必都靠谱。

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} intimidating, though. I’m a big, strong man who does big, strong manly things.
lines.zh: : 可我很{i}吓人{/i}啊。我是个又高又壮的男人，干的是又高又壮的男人该干的事。

lines.en: : Like cheering up friends when their lives are falling apart. Or pulling the covers over them when they can’t move. Or letting them watch Gilmore Girls to drown out those nagging inner monologues.
lines.zh: : 比如在朋友人生崩塌时逗她们开心。比如在她们动不了时帮她们盖好被子。比如让她们看《Gilmore Girls》，好盖过脑子里那些喋喋不休的内心独白。

lines.en: : I think I might have to start watching that show next if it really works for that.
lines.zh: : 那要是真那么管用，我可能也得开始看那部剧了。

lines.en: : You’re not scary, Arakawa. And you should stop pretending to be. I don’t like you that way.
lines.zh: : 你一点都不吓人，Arakawa。你也别再装了。我不喜欢你那个样子。

lines.en: : Which way {i}do{/i} you like me then?
lines.zh: : 那你{i}喜欢{/i}我哪个样子？

lines.en: : Like this, obviously.
lines.zh: : 显然就是现在这个样子。

lines.en: : Yeah?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : I suppose it may just be the alcohol, though. And that I will slaughter Rika in the morning for forcing us into this bed together.
lines.zh: : 不过我想也许只是酒精作祟。还有，明早我一定要把 Rika 宰了，谁让她把我们塞进这张床。

lines.en: : Hey, {i}you{/i} forced me into this bed. I offered to sleep in the other room.
lines.zh: : 嘿，是{i}你{/i}把我弄到这张床上的。我本来还提议去另一个房间睡。

lines.en: : I wanted to show you Gilmore Girls.
lines.zh: : 我想给你看《Gilmore Girls》。

lines.en: : No, you just wanted to play two truths and a lie.
lines.zh: : 不，你只是想玩两个真话一个假话。

lines.en: : Tell me something else, then. Something nobody knows.
lines.zh: : 那就再告诉我一件事。一件没人知道的事。

lines.en: : Nobody?
lines.zh: : 没人知道？

lines.en: : Yeah. What good is a friend that you can’t share secrets with?
lines.zh: : 对。不能分享秘密的朋友，有什么用？

lines.en: : I think I’ll have to get back to you with that. I’m not sure there’s anything out there nobody knows about me yet.
lines.zh: : 这个我得回头再答你。我不确定这世上还有什么是没人知道的、关于我的事。

lines.en: : No deeply buried secrets?
lines.zh: : 没有深埋的秘密？

lines.en: : I imagine there are and I just haven’t found them yet. But I also imagine they are very, very sad.
lines.zh: : 我想是有的，只是我还没找到。但我也觉得，它们一定非常、非常悲伤。

lines.en: : Probably. You’re a sad man, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。你是个悲伤的男人，Arakawa。

lines.en: : And it’s because I’m a sad man that I should not be making {i}you{/i} sad while you are already on the brink of a mental breakdown.
lines.zh: : 正因为我是个悲伤的男人，才不该在你已经濒临精神崩溃的时候再让{i}你{/i}难过。

lines.en: : The breakdown has already occurred. It’s merely being suppressed by my blood alcohol level at the moment.
lines.zh: : 崩溃早就发生了。现在只是被我的血液酒精浓度压着而已。

lines.en: : Then here’s hoping that waking up beside me cures you and you’ll never have to worry again.
lines.zh: : 那就指望一觉醒来躺在我身边能治好你，从此你再也不用发愁了。

lines.en: : It won’t.
lines.zh: : 不会的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t think so either.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也不这么认为。

lines.en: : Can I tell {i}you{/i} something next? Something I’ve already told you once?
lines.zh: : 那接下来我能告诉{i}你{/i}一件事吗？一件我已经跟你说过一次的事。

lines.en: : You may. I just hope it’s one of those “cute Wakana” things and not just you being mean to me again.
lines.zh: : 请说。只希望是那种「可爱的 Wakana」的事，而不是你又来损我。

lines.en: : Oh. Then, maybe I should just keep it to myself.
lines.zh: : 哦。那我也许还是别说好了。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}what is it? Just tell me.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}到底是什么？说吧。

lines.en: : It’s nothing much, really.
lines.zh: : 也没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : Just that you’re a lot uglier up close.
lines.zh: : 只是你近距离看丑多了。

lines.en: scene wakanasex9
: Ah, yes. Thank you for that.
lines.zh: : 啊，是吗。多谢夸奖。

lines.en: : Don’t mention it. Just thought I’d share.
lines.zh: : 不客气。只是想跟你分享一下。

lines.en: scene wakanasex10
: Mmmh! Mmfh! Mmnh! {i}Ah!{/i} Aah...aaahnf...haaah...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯！唔嗯！呣嗯！{i}啊！{/i}啊啊……嗯啊……哈啊……

lines.en: : Mnch...mlm...mmmf...
lines.zh: : 呣……呣呣……呣呣呣……

lines.en: : Aahmmf! Mmmfh! Mmmfhhh!
lines.zh: : 啊呣！唔呣！呣呣呣！

lines.en: scene wakanasex11
: Wakana, we-
lines.zh: : Wakana，我们——

lines.en: : Just shut the fuck up and take my pants off...
lines.zh: : 给我他妈的闭嘴，把我的裤子脱了……

lines.en: scene wakanasex12
: Aaah! Haah! A...Arakawa!...I...hah...gave you {i}one{/i} order and-
lines.zh: : 啊啊！哈啊！A……Arakawa！……我……哈……就给了你{i}一个{/i}指令，结果——

lines.en: : Still calling me that even now?
lines.zh: : 事到如今还这么叫我？

lines.en: : You like it, you...fucking pervert!
lines.zh: : 你喜欢这么叫，你……他妈的变态！

lines.en: : You like it too, Wakana. I can already feel how wet you are through your pajamas.
lines.zh: : 你也喜欢，Wakana。隔着睡衣我都能感觉到你有多湿了。

lines.en: scene wakanasex13
: I already...told you! I’m...drunk! It’s clearly just...the alcohol!
lines.zh: : 我早就……说过了！我……醉了！这显然只是……酒精的缘故！

lines.en: : Then I guess-
lines.zh: : 那我猜——

lines.en: : If you even think about stopping I will chop it off in the middle of the night! Don’t you {i}dare{/i} quit on me now or a...terrible fate will befall you!
lines.zh: : 你只要敢想着停下来，我就半夜把它剁了！你现在{i}敢{/i}给我收手试试，不然……会有可怕的下场等着你！

lines.en: : Tell the truth. How long have you wanted this for?
lines.zh: : 说实话。你想要这个多久了？

lines.en: scene wakanasex14
: I...haven’t! Haven’t you ever heard of a...moment of passion?! Now keep your fucking mouth shut and just-
lines.zh: : 我……没有！你没听说过什么叫……一时冲动吗？！现在给我把他妈的嘴闭上，只管——

lines.en: scene wakanasex15

lines.zh: : 啊！……什么……哈啊！

lines.en: : Oh, you’re {i}sensitive,{/i} aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哦，你很{i}敏感{/i}啊？

lines.en: : I’m not...normally! Just....aaah....right there, I.......aah!
lines.zh: : 我平时……不是！就是……啊啊……就是那里，我……啊！

lines.en: : You’re even cuter than I thought you’d be like this...
lines.zh: : 你这样子比我想的还要可爱……

lines.en: scene wakanasex16
: Oh, you’ve seen me before you fucking {i}demon.{/i} Don’t even pretend you weren’t looking at me back then.
lines.zh: : 哦，你以前又不是没看过，你他妈这个{i}恶魔{/i}。别装作你当时没在看我。

lines.en: : Don’t pretend you weren’t looking at me either, then.
lines.zh: : 那你也别装作你没在看我。

lines.en: : It’s not my fault your fucking cock took up half the bed! Why on earth would someone as terrible as you even be {i}blessed{/i} with such an impressive feature in the first place?!
lines.zh: : 你那根该死的鸡巴占了半张床，这能怪我吗？！像你这么烂的人，凭什么偏偏还被{i}赐予{/i}这么了不起的家伙啊？！

lines.en: : To better cheer up my friends when they’re in need.
lines.zh: : 为了更好地在朋友需要时逗她们开心。

lines.en: : Rika is going to fucking {i}die{/i} in the-
lines.zh: : Rika 他妈的要{i}死{/i}在——

lines.en: scene wakanasex15
: Aaah! Ah! Ah! Aaah!
lines.zh: : 啊！啊！啊！啊！

lines.en: : I’m gonna take your pants off now, okay?
lines.zh: : 我现在要脱你裤子了，好吗？

lines.en: : Okay! Yes! Do that! Okay!
lines.zh: : 好！对！脱！好！

lines.en: scene wakanasex17
: Just...be gentle please. My back is-
lines.zh: : 只是……请温柔点。我的背——

lines.en: : I know. I’ll try not to hurt you. But if I do, just tell me and I’ll stop.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我尽量不弄疼你。但如果疼了，就告诉我，我会停下。

lines.en: : Tell you to {i}stop?{/i} No. After you’ve been dreaming of this for essentially your entire life, it’d be incredibly rude for me to tell you to stop. Just don’t fucking {i}kill{/i} me. I can handle a {i}little{/i} pain.
lines.zh: : 叫你{i}停下{/i}？不。你基本上这辈子都在盼着这一刻，我要是叫你停下，也太不近人情了。别他妈{i}弄死{/i}我就行。{i}一点{/i}疼我还是受得住的。

lines.en: scene wakanasex18
: It wouldn’t be easier for you to get on top, would it?
